title: [review] tx_queue.py:410: confirm_transmitted() does not
description: confirm_transmitted() calls _remove_first() which updates stats but never signals the reservation as True. Even though transmission succeeded, any caller awaiting the reservation will hang indefinitely. The complete() method correctly signals reservations, but confirm_transmitted() does not.
close_reason: Fixed: confirm_transmitted() now signals reservation as True before calling _remove_first(). Added test_confirm_transmitted_signals_reservation to verify.
